The tumor shows marked contrast enhancement, presence of necrosis (5.56% of volume), deep white‑matter and ependymal invasion, and a large enhancing component (ET volume 10.9 mL, 16.3% of total), all imaging hallmarks of IDH‑wildtype high‑grade glioma.
